sloka: दिवसश्चास्य मर्यादा यं द्रष्टा श्वोऽस्मि वानरम् ।बहुवर्षसहस्राणि स वै शैलो भविष्यति ॥४-११-५८॥।।
transliteration: divasaścāsya maryādā yaṁ draṣṭā śvo'smi vānaram ।bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi sa vai śailo bhaviṣyati ॥4-11-58॥।।

translations.english: 'I give one day's time for the monkeys (to leave). Whomsoever, I see tomorrow will get transformed into a mountain for many thousands of years'
